items.title: What Datadog Holders Saw Early
items.summary: If you only glanced at Datadog headlines this year, the sharp selloffs after cautious guidance might stick in your mind more than the blockbuster AI wins. items.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Mixed Views On Q4 And AI Demand
items.summary: Datadog’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$292.36 to US$271.71 per share, which marks a modest reset in how the stock is being valued today. Analysts are split, with some pointing to strong Q3 results, AI related demand and Datadog’s broad customer base, while others lean on softer Q4 guidance, early renewals and volume discounts when considering where the stock should trade.
